address: 61 Jermyn Street, St James’s, London, SW1Y 6LX, United Kingdom
bio: One of London’s oldest Italian restaurants, this reliably enjoyable spot has benefitted from the years of practice. The kitchen focuses on an extensive menu of classically based dishes like veal and beef lasagne or linguine with lobster, with each one proving to be uncomplicated and well-executed. The many regulars come back time and again for their favourite dishes and the intimate, cosy atmosphere. The wine list is joyfully Italian, with some wonderful barolos among the choices....
